notes:
- Automatically recognises new and reset account licences on the next verified device check, while preserving existing device ownership and revoked licences.
- Checks licences before opening the app and when Launch RL is used. The profile shows Lite, Plus or Missing License based on a verified active licence.
- Imports preset codes directly with Add to Your Presets; the Preview step has been removed.
- Lite and Plus users can add titles to the local BondoMod spawn list during an authorised Spawner session. In-game title spawning and equipping are still unsupported; local titles are excluded from game delivery.
- Keeps the eight-minute voluntary diagnostic recording and existing Spawner and launcher fixes.
- Device binding remains constant across BondoMod updates, reinstalls and test profiles on the same Windows installation. Existing installation-specific bindings migrate once using a signed account licence receipt.
